baby_development: Baby grows quickly, bones harden, and you may feel first movements (quickening).
mother_symptoms: Energy often returns. Possible back pain, round-ligament pain, and mild swelling.
diet_advice: Eat iron-rich foods, calcium (milk, ragi, leafy greens), protein, and fiber. Continue prenatal vitamins. Drink plenty of water.
warning_signs: Vaginal bleeding, severe headache, sudden swelling, reduced baby movement, high fever.
